from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Citation information for a single paper from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as named in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper cites")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationInfo]
